nodes.title: LoRA stack (inert until a slot is set)
REWRITER (story -> chained shot prompts)

je_widget_values.story_idea: Two people talk across a booth in a late-night roadside diner about an impossible power outage: the whole street went dark for six minutes but her repair shop kept running, its lights got brighter, and the meter outside ran backwards. He is a sceptical man in his fifties in a faded blue mechanic's jacket; she is a woman in her late twenties in an oversized cream sweater and round wire-frame glasses. One warm pendant lamp above the table is the only light, rain on the window behind them, static camera at the end of the table holding both of them in a two-shot the whole time. Four shots, one continuous conversation, no camera cuts.

nodes.title: REMOTE ENCODER - how to
widgets_values:
REMOTE ENCODER  (optional)

Runs the text encoder on a second PC, so this card never loads it. Repeated scene text is answered from a local cache without touching the network at all.

To use it:
1. On the other PC: install this node pack (+ ComfyUI-GGUF for .gguf    encoders), put the encoder file in models/text_encoders, and launch    ComfyUI with  --listen 0.0.0.0  added to its start line.
2. Set endpoint to that PC, e.g. http://ITS-NAME:8188
3. Set clip_name to the encoder file's name ON THAT PC.
4. Turn remote_encoder ON in the VRAM / SPEED SWITCHES panel - it
   drives the ENCODER switch. OFF = normal local encoding, exactly as
   before.

The first request is slow - the other PC loads the encoder once, then keeps it ready. If that PC is off, the render stops with a clear message: flip the switch back OFF and render locally.

nodes.title: BEFORE YOU UN-BYPASS
widgets_values:
EXTRA VRAM SWITCHES (advanced)

These two nodes lower peak VRAM (memory-efficient attention, chunked feed-forward) and need ComfyUI-sol-attn installed first - link in SETTINGS.md. Install, un-bypass them (Ctrl+B), then turn sol_attn / chunk_ffn ON in the VRAM / SPEED SWITCHES panel. Without the pack, leave them alone (bypassed) and everything works.

h3_widget_values.script:
A static camera sits at the end of the table and frames both of them from the chest up in a two-shot; the framing never changes. Live-action, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm grain. A man in his fifties with close-cropped grey hair, deep lines around the eyes and a heavy salt-and-pepper moustache, wearing a faded blue mechanic's jacket over a white t-shirt sits on one side of a late-night roadside diner booth: cracked red vinyl seats, a scratched formica table with two chipped white coffee mugs and a steel napkin dispenser, a rain-streaked window behind them reflecting an empty parking lot, and one warm pendant lamp directly above the table as the only light, the rest of the diner falling away into darkness. Across from him sits a woman in her late twenties with dark curly hair tied back, round wire-frame glasses and chipped green nail polish, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater. He leans forward on his forearms, turning his mug slowly on the table, and the man in the faded blue mechanic's jacket says, "So let me get this straight. The whole street goes dark for six minutes - traffic lights, the gas station, everything - and your shop keeps its lights on." He settles back against the vinyl with both hands around his mug and waits, watching her.
---

Across from him sits a woman in her late twenties with dark curly hair tied back, round wire-frame glasses and chipped green nail polish, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater. nodes.title: AUTO REFS (one folder per character under refs_root)
REFERENCE IMAGES
widgets_values:
CHARACTER PHOTOS (optional)

AUTO: switch USE AUTO REFS on - that alone is enough. One folder per character under input/h3_refs/ (folder name = the name used in your premise); the premise is scanned, the photos go to the sampler, and the writer is told to point at them instead of describing a face (measured: a written description overrides the photographs). No folder matches? It warns in the console and renders without photos - the run does not stop (on_no_match).

MANUAL: leave USE AUTO REFS off, load photos into the two REFERENCE slots and switch the MANUAL REFS gate on. The writer will still describe the person in that mode - if you use the writer, put the photos in a folder and use AUTO instead.

Two different people? Set reference_subjects on the sampler: "3,3" means photos 1-3 are person A, photos 4-6 are person B. Skip this and faces will blend.

nodes.title: FFLF BOUNDARY PLATES
widgets_values:
BOUNDARY PLATES (only if continuity = flf_chain)

Give it pictures of where each shot should START and END.
3 shots = 4 pictures. PLATE 0 is your opening frame.

Easiest way that actually looks right: take ONE wide picture and crop all your plates out of it.

Be sure to enable the toggle to the left.

nodes.title: AUDIO SPINE
widgets_values:
AUDIO SPINE (optional)

One long audio track (a song, a voiceover) that the whole video follows - lips included. Pick the file FIRST, then unmute the loader.

nodes.title: V2V REFERENCE
widgets_values:
VIDEO REFERENCE (optional - ships muted)

Hand it a video clip and your render copies that clip's look, room and framing (NOT its motion). Community tip: load a single IMAGE here and add "Start Frame is <Video 1>." to your prompt - a decent soft start-frame.

(Thanks snake88.)

Unmute all four nodes together, keep clips under ~10 seconds.

nodes.title: H3 EXTEND TAKE - read me
widgets_values:
**EXTEND TAKE - one prompt, one continuous speech, as long as you want.** Type a length into MASTER CONTROLS `take_seconds`; the panel sizes the window for your card (`window` = auto) and the count that fills the time. The writer (join style: extend take) writes ONE speech and cuts it across the windows - no airlock, no settle, no per-shot budgeting. Premise goes in MANUAL SCENE IDEA; one speaker works best. Set the writer's model_name to a model you have (hosted/cloud is best). Known limit: very long takes slowly sharpen - keep takes to about 4 windows for now.

## MiniMax-H3 EXTEND TAKE

**Guides**
- [The 5-minute guide](https://civitai.com/articles/34047/make-talking-videos-with-minimax-h3-the-5-minute-guide-26)
- [Every setting explained (deep manual)](https://civitai.com/articles/34046/every-setting-explained-the-seamless-chain-deep-manual)

**Updates**
- [Civitai page](https://civitai.com/models/2833322)
- [HuggingFace workflow repo](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-Multishot-Workflow)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jlucasmcrell/ComfyUI-H3-Multishot)

**Model files (DiT)**
- [curve GGUFs](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-curve-GGUF)
- [comfy-native ref2va](https://civitai.com/models/2857809)

**Text encoder + VAEs**
- [encoder GGUF](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-encoder-GGUF)
- [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

Nodes: search **H3 Multishot** in ComfyUI-Manager

nodes.title: ANCHORS
widgets_values:
ANCHORS (optional, all off by default)

IDENTITY IMAGE: a photo of your character, so shot 1 starts from their look.
VOICE ANCHOR: a short voice clip to set how they sound. Pick the file FIRST, then unmute the loader.

Leave off = the video invents its own people and voices. That's fine.

nodes.title: PROMPT SOURCE
widgets_values:
WRITE YOUR SCENE

Option 1 - let the AI write it: describe your idea in story_idea, press Run.
  num_shots 0 = it decides how many shots.
Option 2 - write it yourself: put mode on passthrough and paste your own
  script: one paragraph per shot, --- on its own line between shots.

Keep spoken lines SHORT - about 8-12 words per shot. Long lines come out
garbled; tiny lines get stretched and sound slow.

nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
START HERE

ONE premise -> ONE video with sound: a person talking straight through for the length you ask, in one continuous take.

1. Premise in MANUAL SCENE IDEA (name the person if you'll give it photos).
2. REWRITER: pick a model you have (hosted / cloud is best).
3. MASTER CONTROLS: take_seconds (30 ships; 60 clears TikTok's minute).
4. Press Run. One joined video comes out.

Your character's photos: input/h3_refs/<Name>/ + flip USE AUTO REFS. That's all.

24 GB card: use 1152x640 (3x faster). Every panel below is optional.
Guides: the read-me note to the LEFT has the links.

nodes.title: SAMPLER
widgets_values:
SAMPLER

Size, seconds and steps are set in MASTER CONTROLS - not here.

The dials here are already set to the best-tested values. The one you might touch: continuity. context_pin = one continuous take (default).

cut = separate shots with camera cuts between them.
